description: Skelet AF-09-ii handoff surfaces: REST/MCP/UI parity over the AF-09-i handoff domain

compatibility.instructions: Do the 3 new board routes, 3 new MCP tools, and board UI section preserve existing contracts: board CRUD shapes, lens tool schemas, the 13-tool list expectation (now 16 with additive tools), envelope version skelet.agent.v1, and URI schemes skelet://collection/{id}? Are the interop count updates (13->16) the only contract change, with older clients unaffected?

correctness.instructions: Is the surfaces logic factually correct: MCP board_handoff/board_list_handoffs/board_validate_items delegate to the same boards.ts route layer as REST (identical envelopes/codes/messages by construction); boardId-or-URI resolution requires agreement and fails INVALID_INPUT when missing/mismatched; REST routes bind path id with bearer/rate-limit guards; UI calls /handoff, /handoffs, /validation with bearer auth and renders handoff chain plus ok/denied/missing validation? Do REST and MCP converge on the same ledger row?

evidence.instructions: Are the tests sufficient: boards.test.mjs handoff lifecycle plus authority/recipient/locator denial matrix; mcp-boards.test.mjs advertise plus REST/MCP convergence plus oracle-free denial; boards-ui assertions for routes/markers/states; updated mcp/interop tool counts; typecheck/lint/build green; full pnpm test 107/107? Is the lens-jobs expiry fix (BASE+31 -> now+32d) a minimal time-robustness repair with preserved intent?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism: handoff transfer stays in the AF-09-i single-transaction domain layer; surfaces add no new transactions, locks, or retries; MCP resolution is pure; UI refresh is idempotent GET? Any half-transfer or duplicate-ledger path introduced at the surfaces layer?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond handoff surfaces: new capture, unrelated refactors, paid services, or base board CRUD changes? Is the lens-jobs expiry test fix the only adjacent change, clearly justified as a CI-blocking time bomb? Are base board CRUD and lens domains untouched?

security.instructions: Do surfaces leak or escalate: malformed board identifiers answer FORBIDDEN_OR_NOT_FOUND (no oracle); missing/mismatched identifiers answer INVALID_INPUT; outsider-vs-missing handoff/list/validate answer identically; workspace aliasing rejected; recipient must be a member; non-owner handoff denied; denied validation items expose status only; bearer/rate-limit guards on all 3 REST routes; no secrets, remote code, or model egress?

state.change: AF-09-ii: handoff REST routes (handoff/handoffs/validation), MCP board_handoff/board_list_handoffs/board_validate_items with shared route-layer parity, board UI handoff section, boards+MCP+UI tests, interop count updates, lens-jobs expiry time-robustness fix.
